trait.name: Keen Smell
entries: The lion has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

trait.name: Pounce
entries: If the lion moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. If the target is {@condition prone}, the lion can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

trait.name: Running Leap
entries: With a 10-foot running start, the lion can long jump up to 25 feet.

trait.name: Antimagic Mane
entries: The lion's mane can absorb nearby spells using the Spell Catching reaction. Each wisp consumes part of the lion's mane, and reduces it's AC by 2

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lion makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claw.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) slashing damage.

reaction.name: Spell Catching
entries: {@actTrigger} When the lion is targeted by a spell, or within 10ft of an active spell effect. {@actResponse} The lion's mane absorbs the spell, and creates a spell wisp. The wisp gains abilities mimicing the absorbed spell.

legendary.name: Claw
entries: The lion makes one claw attack.

legendary.name: Wisp absorption
entries: The lion reabsorbs one spell wisp within 30ft, and regains the reduced AC from that wisp.

legendary.name: Roar (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The lion emits a magical roar. Each creature within 60 feet of the lion that can hear the roar must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of the lion until the end of the lion's next turn.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: The mephit explodes when it dies. {@actSave dex} {@dc 10}, each creature in a 5-foot originating from the wisp. {@actSaveFail} 5 ({@damage 2d4}) damage, of a type associated with the spell, or inflict an associated condition until the end of their next turn.

action.name: Spell Burst (Damage)
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) damage of a type associated with the spell.

action.name: Spell Burst (Condition)
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 10}, each creature in a 10-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} The target has one condition inflicted by the absorbed spell until the end of the wisps's next turn.

action.name: Spell Buff
entries: One willing creature gains the effect of the absorbed spell until the end of the target's next turn.
